meta.title: Static Analysis Audit: Broker & Streaming Adapters
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Run static analysis tools on all broker adapters, streaming adapters, and data modules, capturing findings in structured YAML files.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: ruff check passes on all broker adapters in live/brokers/ (or findings documented)
ruff check passes on all streaming modules in live/streaming/ (or findings documented)
mypy passes on all broker and streaming modules (or type errors documented)
All findings captured in brokers_findings.yaml and streaming_findings.yaml
Each finding includes specific line numbers and recommendations

key-tasks.task: Run ruff check on all files in live/brokers/ directory
Run ruff check on all files in live/streaming/ directory
Run mypy on broker and streaming modules

architecture-context.pattern: All broker adapters implement BrokerAdapter ABC with consistent interface
All streaming adapters implement BaseWebSocketAdapter ABC

technical-specifications.spec:
Brokers: - rustybt/live/brokers/base.py - rustybt/live/brokers/hyperliquid_adapter.py - rustybt/live/brokers/paper_broker.py
Streaming: - rustybt/live/streaming/base.py - rustybt/live/streaming/hyperliquid_stream.py - rustybt/live/streaming/bar_buffer.py

dependencies.dependency: Audit infrastructure and findings schema must exist

nfr-references.nfr: WebSocket reconnection must complete within 30 seconds
API keys and private keys MUST never be logged

testing-requirements.test: ruff check on all broker modules
ruff check on all streaming modules
